title: Column equals the sum of rows
statement: Let $a,b$ be finite bit strings and let $j$ be a nonnegative integer. The sum, over positions $q$ in $a$, of the row sum formed from the bit of $a$ at $q$ and $b$ at indices $j,q$ equals the column sum formed from $a,b$ at position $j$. In both sums, missing bits are taken to be $0$.
